# Bookey

> Bookey is a book summary platform offering 30-minute audio and text summaries from 1000+ bestsellers, designed for lifelong learners seeking quick access to key insights.

Bookey provides curated book summaries, chapter breakdowns, quote indexes, and free public-domain reading materials across self-help, personal development, psychology, and productivity categories. The platform serves as a comprehensive learning resource for readers looking to extract actionable insights from bestselling books efficiently.

## Core Platform

- [Bookey Homepage](https://www.bookey.app): Bookey homepage: 30-min audio/text summaries from 1000+ bestsellers
- [Bookey Library](https://www.bookey.app/library): World-class community for lifelong learners with curated book summaries
- [Bestseller Book Lists](https://www.bookey.app/booklist): Curated bestseller lists with themed-based reading collections

## Book Summaries & References

- [Atomic Habits by James Clear](https://www.bookey.app/book/atomic-habits): Atomic Habits chapter summary and free PDF on habit formation
- [The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People by Stephen Covey](https://www.bookey.app/book/the-7-habits-of-highly-effective-people): 7 Habits chapter summary: transformative success framework
- [How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie](https://www.bookey.app/book/how-to-win-friends-and-influence-people): How to Win Friends chapter summary: relationship building guide
- [12 Rules for Life by Jordan Peterson](https://www.bookey.app/book/12-rules-for-life): 12 Rules for Life chapter summary: antidote to chaos
- [Mini Habits by Stephen Guise](https://www.bookey.app/book/mini-habits): Mini Habits chapter summary: smaller habits, bigger results
- [Personality Isn't Permanent by Benjamin Hardy](https://www.bookey.app/book/personality-isn%27t-permanent): Personality Isn't Permanent chapter summary: break limiting beliefs

## Science & Psychology Books

- [Brain Rules by John Medina](https://www.bookey.app/book/brain-rules): Brain Rules chapter summary: optimize brain potential and cognitive performance
- [Spark by John J. Ratey](https://www.bookey.app/book/spark-by-john-j-ratey): Spark chapter summary: exercise and brain science connection
- [Range by David Epstein](https://www.bookey.app/book/range): Range chapter summary: why generalists triumph in specialized world
- [Late Bloomers by Rich Karlgaard](https://www.bookey.app/book/late-bloomers): Late Bloomers chapter summary and review on timing and success

## Learning & Communication

- [TED Talks by Chris Anderson](https://www.bookey.app/book/ted-talks): TED Talks chapter summary: official public speaking guide
- [Quote Index by Topic and Author](https://www.bookey.app/quote-index): Searchable quote index from bestsellers organized by topic and author
- [Free Online Reading Library](https://www.bookey.app/freebook-index): Free online reading of public-domain books in multiple formats

## Time Management & Productivity

- [The 10 Natural Laws of Time and Life Management by Hyrum W. Smith](https://www.bookey.app/book/the-10-natural-laws-of-successful-time-and-life-management): Time and life management chapter summary by Hyrum W. Smith
- [Procrastination by Jane Burka & Lenora Yuen](https://www.bookey.app/book/procrastination-by-jane-burka%2C-lenora-yuen): Procrastination chapter summary: comprehensive guide to overcome procrastination
- [Poor Charlie's Almanack by Peter Kaufman](https://www.bookey.app/book/poor-charlie%27s-almanack-by-peter-kaufman): Poor Charlie's Almanack chapter summary: Charles Munger investment wisdom
